retained_results_and_limits: Appendix A already supplies the consistent core signs and dimensional pressure coefficient.
The modeled reconnection rate, outflow-time normalization and conditional coalescence/critical-balance exponents retain their algebraic support.
The finite-beta extension is explicitly hypothetical because ideal ERMHD lacks flux-breaking physics.
No statement about actual GX signs, density-energy diagnostics, simulation correctness or observed decay follows from these printed-expression witnesses.
